faq.q: What is a titanium pocket comb?
faq.a: A titanium pocket comb is a precision-machined edc component used in premium titanium pocket comb. Manufactured from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: What is the typical application for titanium pocket comb?
faq.a: Titanium Pocket Comb is designed for premium titanium pocket comb. The Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V grade is selected to provide the optimal balance of strength, fatigue life, and environmental resistance for this specific application.

faq.q: What CNC equipment is used for titanium pocket comb?
faq.a: Titanium Pocket Comb is machined on 5-axis CNC equipment with high-pressure coolant (1000 psi) to manage titanium's low thermal conductivity and work-hardening tendency. Tolerances of +-0.01mm are standard.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium pocket comb?
faq.a: The most common issue is surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (astm f86). Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.
